items.html: And in the ninth year and one day, the Daat of the Tzelem enters, which is within the Yesod of Tevunah, and enters into the Daat of ZA; and the corona of the Yesod of Tevunah enters into the Tifferet of ZA, in the first third, until its chest. And behold, all three lines of ZA are completed: right, left, and middle.
